messages.author: c40d2469f7cdd6b5
messages.subject: Authorize a domain of users
parts: In the paid tier of shinyapps.io, under users, is it possible to authorize a domain of users. Example: all users with an email *@testcompany.com? Instead of entering one email at a time can we use a wildcard and a domain?

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Authorize a domain of users
parts: This is not possible today. What you can do is use the rsconnect package to programmatically authorize users though.

On Monday, July 16, 2018 at 12:56:58 PM UTC-4, Akash Sadashivapeth wrote:
